tasks.title: Provider credential + status routes: GET /api/connectors/providers, PUT/DELETE /:provider/credential, wired to the bootstrapper
acceptance: ConnectorProviderStatusSchema ({ type, configured, registered, custody, disclosure, error? }) added to @dorkos/shared/connector-provider with TSDoc; no field can carry a secret or reference value.

PUT /api/connectors/providers/:provider/credential (body { secret }) stores via credentialStore.put under COMPOSIO_CREDENTIAL_NAME / NANGO_CREDENTIAL_NAME (mirroring storeRuntimeCredential in services/runtimes/connect/credentials.ts), then bootstrapper.reload(provider), returns the fresh status — saving a Composio key registers the provider with NO server restart (gap 1+2 closed end to end).
DELETE removes the credential (add CredentialStore.delete if absent — spec OQ1), reloads, is idempotent (missing key still 200).
Express 5 semantics handled (req.body ?? {}); unknown provider 400; empty secret 400; secret never appears in any response, log line, or error message.

tasks.title: DOR-415: Nango Proxy→MCP wrapper, exposesOverMcp flip, conformance true-branch, three review nits
acceptance: nango-proxy-mcp.ts hosts a stateless-per-request Streamable HTTP McpServer at /api/connectors/nango/mcp/:accountId exposing one generic proxy_request tool ({ method, path, query?, body?, headers? }) forwarded to Nango's credentialed proxy with Provider-Config-Key + Connection-Id headers; tool description names service + label; responses size-capped; endpoint shapes marked ASSUMPTION (live-unverified) like nango-client.ts.
Per-account process-scoped bearer tokens minted at toolServerForAccount time; endpoint 401s without a valid token; tokens never persisted or logged.

NangoConnectorProvider: exposesOverMcp true; toolServerForAccount returns { transport: 'http', url, headers } for active accounts and null otherwise (documented null branch intact); conformance run in nango.test.ts moved to the exposesOverMcp:true branch.
Nit 1: normalizeStatus makes PENDING an explicit case and defaults unknown statuses to ERROR.
Nit 2: initiateConnection sends end_user: { id: crypto.randomUUID(), display_name: label } — duplicate labels yield distinct ids.
Nit 3: NANGO_BASE_URL is z.string().url().optional() — a malformed address fails env parse at boot.
tasks.testPlan: pnpm vitest run apps/server/src/services/connectors/providers/__tests__/nango-proxy-mcp.test.ts (proxy forwarding shape via injected fetch, bearer 401, size cap, secret-free responses) and __tests__/nango.test.ts (true-branch conformance; toolServerForAccount null for non-active). pnpm vitest run apps/server/src/services/connectors/providers/__tests__/nango-client.test.ts (unknown status → ERROR; distinct end_user ids for same label). env test: malformed NANGO_BASE_URL rejected.
